title: Gas N Fire
description: A mod that adds gas and fire [basically arson]. currently in beta
body:
A mod that adds arson. I got this idea when playing The Broken Script and I was removing a Pillager outpost with some flint and steel. I got the idea of an arson mod and so I made this.
This mod adds a few things like two lighter types, two gas can types, **CHEESE**, and many more things
